name: Spoiling Children
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of balanced and God-centered child-rearing, urging parents to train their children in the right way so they remain faithful throughout life (Proverbs 22:6). Correction is necessary and should not be withheld, as it guides children without causing harm (Proverbs 23:13). At the same time, fathers are warned against provoking their children to anger, which can lead to discouragement (Colossians 3:21). Ultimately, the foundation for spoiling or disciplining children rests on walking in the fear of the Lord and treating others as we would want to be treated (Psalms 128:1; Matthew 7:12), recognizing God's nearness and care for His people (Deuteronomy 4:7).
